9to5Mac Daily records a new episode every weekday. Subscribe to our podcast on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast player to make sure new episodes are delivered as soon as they're released.

Stories discussed in this episode:

  • Apple announces price increases for Apple TV and Apple One subscriptions
  • iPhone 18 Pro pre-order dates may be slightly later than usual
  • Report suggests Apple Watch Series 12 may include all-day heart rate monitoring and a brand-new Fitness app
